name: Field-Aggregation Transformer
definition: A transformer block that aggregates features across the view dimension (Nviews) to produce 3D semantic-embedding fields (S_3D_rgb, S_3D_sem) from epipolar view features.
summary: The Field-Aggregation Transformer co-aggregates radiance and semantic features from multiple views using a unified attention mechanism, jointly optimizing geometry and semantics for enhanced 3D scene understanding.
